next.reason: 1985: 'The range of the output procedure must not cause the execution of any MERGE, RELEASE, or SORT statement.'; 2023: 'shall not cause the execution of any MERGE, RELEASE, or the file format of the SORT statement. ... EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE exception condition is set'. Same output-procedure range rule, but 2023 bans only file-format SORT and defines a violation as setting EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE with undefined results.
